download.title: Your Japanese workspace is almost here.
download.description: Download options for Windows, macOS and Linux will be available here soon. YomiFlow keeps your study library on your device.

notebook.title: A notebook built for understanding Japanese
notebook.description: Turn reading into a connected study practice with rich notes, linguistic analysis and tools that help you see what you already know.

benefits.first: Write naturally in a TipTap-powered editor and keep notes alongside your study materials.
benefits.second: Explore syntax trees and morphology to understand how each sentence works.
benefits.third: Use the linter and MorphMan estimates to refine notes and choose your next reading.

audioVault.title: Your listening library, always within reach
audioVault.description: Audio Vault brings local audio, a persistent player and queue together, while OmniSearch makes your growing library easy to revisit.

benefits.first: Keep a global player and queue available as you move between study activities.
benefits.second: Save listening materials locally and continue learning offline.
benefits.third: Search notes, cards and cached content with SQLite FTS5.

immersion.title: Learn from the Japanese you love
immersion.description: Bring manga, video subtitles and articles into one offline-first reading flow, with dynamic furigana and quick access to vocabulary.

benefits.first: Adjust furigana dynamically to match your reading level.
benefits.second: Look up words without losing the sentence and media context.
benefits.third: Send useful vocabulary into spaced repetition for lasting recall.

about.title: Built with care for the long journey of learning Japanese.
about.story: YomiFlow is architected by Erick Gabriel dos Santos Alves with a simple belief: a thoughtful study tool should support curiosity, consistency and ownership. The product brings reading, listening, writing and review into one calm workspace designed to grow with each learner.
about.credentials: Its engineering reflects robust principles shaped by postgraduate studies in Software Engineering at Faculdade Descomplica, alongside a community-minded approach strengthened through selection as a Google Student Ambassador 2026.
